PAGE.TITLE: Codex CLI
PAGE.CONTENT:
Command line (dochttps://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/cli/reference
enHTML)
codex resume Continue a previous interactive session by ID.
codex update Check for and apply a Codex CLI update when the installed release supports self-update.
Slash commands (dochttps://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/cli/slash-commands
enHTML)
/exit
/quit Exit the CLI.
/init create an AGENTS.md file with instructions for Codex.
/status Show current session configuration.
/permissions Choose what Codex is allowed to do.
/model Choose what model and reasoning effort to use.
/plugins Browse installed and discoverable plugins.
/review Review any changes and find issues.
/usage View account token usage or use a rate-limit reset.
/side
/btw Start an ephemeral side chat.
To declare a global MCP server codex mcp add \ gitlab \ --env GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN="$GITLAB_TOKEN" \ --env GITLAB_API_URL="https://gitlab.com" \ --env GITLAB_PERMISSION_MODE=readonly \ --env GITLAB_TOOLSETS=projects,merge_requests,issues \ -- npx -y @zereight/mcp-gitlab@2.1.65 (Declaring a local server needs to modify .codex/config.toml.)
